Security architecture

Controls across the request lifecycle.

InspectReal-time in-flight inspection

Inspect each prompt and response as it moves through the gateway. Detect, mask, or block personally identifiable information, protected health information, API keys, and corporate secrets before they reach foundation models.

AuthorizeCentralized role-based access

Synchronize with Okta, Azure AD, or PingFederate. Grant model permissions by role, security clearance, or project team without distributing static AWS access keys.

LimitPre-execution budget caps

Set monthly and daily spending limits for applications, departments, and autonomous agents. When a threshold is reached, apply your fallback policy before computation begins.

RecordImmutable audit evidence

Write prompt inspections, blocked attempts, and model invocations to tamper-evident logs. Generate compliance reports mapped to the EU AI Act, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA Security Rules, and ISO 27001.
